title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: localised default result email for user reported messages
summary: Pass: the rollout dates, conditional default, licensing context and published controls match Microsoft's sources. The statement that data access is unchanged should be narrowed to the documented statements about verdicts, classification and investigation behaviour.

claims.claim: Default admin-review result emails for user reported messages are localised.
claims.quote: The default admin review outcome email is automatically localized based on the recipient's preferred language.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The recipient's Outlook language settings determine the preferred language of default notification emails.
claims.quote: When automatic notifications use the default template, users receive notification emails in their preferred language based on their Outlook language settings.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; controls[2].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Localisation is on automatically when automatic notifications use the default template.
claims.quote: Localized default templates are enabled automatically when automatic notifications are turned on.

claims.claim: The documented supported languages include English, Japanese, Spanish, French and German.
claims.quote: Localized default notification templates support the following languages: English, Japanese, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified) ... Vietnamese, French, Italian, and German.

claims.claim: Manual Mark as and notify actions on the Submissions page use the default result email template.
claims.quote: The notification email uses the same template as when an admin selects ... Mark as and notify on the Submissions page at https://security.microsoft.com/reportsubmission.

claims.claim: Automatic investigation result notifications also use the default template.
claims.quote: This default template is used for manual Mark as and notify actions and automatic investigation result notifications.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The localisation feature does not change or localise admin-configured custom notification templates.
claims.quote: The feature doesn't affect custom notification templates configured by admins.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Customising the email body or footer sends the configured text instead of the localised default.
claims.quote: If you customize the email body or footer, recipients receive the text that you configure instead of the localized default text.

claims.quote: This email doesn’t appear harmful. But you should always handle suspicious emails with caution.

claims.claim: The notice says the safe-message template advises confirming validity with the sender through another channel.
claims.quote: Contact the sender through another channel to confirm the message’s validity.

claims.claim: The notice says the safe-message template advises avoiding links and attachments in unsolicited email from unfamiliar senders.
claims.quote: Avoid links and attachments in unsolicited emails from unfamiliar senders.

claims.quote: In Microsoft 365 organizations with Exchange Online mailboxes and Microsoft Defender for Office 365, admins can send templated result messages back to users after they review the user reported messages.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The customisation control is in Microsoft Defender portal at Settings > Email & collaboration > User reported settings > Email notifications > Results email > Customize results email.
claims.quote: Settings > Email & collaboration > User reported settings tab. ... Find the Email notifications section ... Results email section: Select Customize results email.

claims.where: controls[0].api; controls[0].note; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: Set-ReportSubmissionPolicy -Identity DefaultReportSubmissionPolicy -PhishingReviewResultMessage <text> sets the custom phishing result text.
claims.quote: The only available policy is named DefaultReportSubmissionPolicy. ... The PhishingReviewResultMessage parameter specifies the custom text to use in result messages after an admin reviews and marks the reported messages as phishing.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: second table row
claims.claim: The automatic-result control is in Microsoft Defender portal at Settings > Email & collaboration > User reported settings > Email notifications > Results email > Automatically email users the results of the investigation.
claims.quote: Settings > Email & collaboration > User reported settings tab. ... In the Email notifications > Results email section, select Automatically email users the results of the investigation

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: second table row and closing paragraph
claims.claim: No usable automation operation is documented for the automatic investigation result notification option.
claims.quote: Searched: Defender Office 365 automatically email users results investigation Set-ReportSubmissionPolicy PowerShell. Read AIR feedback and Set-ReportSubmissionPolicy; NotificationsFor*SubmissionAirInvestigationsEnabled parameters are reserved for internal Microsoft use.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no separate UI switch or API operation for turning default-template localisation off independently.
claims.quote: Searched: Mark as and notify localization disable PowerShell switch; Defender localized default disable. Read Admin review, User reported settings and Set-ReportSubmissionPolicy; no independent localisation switch or usable parameter is documented.

claims.claim: Separate parameters on Set-ReportSubmissionPolicy configure the body text for the other verdicts.
claims.quote: Use the JunkReviewResultMessage, NotJunkReviewResultMessage, PhishingReviewResultMessage parameters to configure the message body text that's used for each verdict.

claims.claim: Custom result text is configured for the organisation and applies to recipients of the corresponding verdict.
claims.quote: Admins can customize the notification message template that's used for the organization. ... Email body results text: Enter the custom text to use. You can use different text for Phishing, Junk and No threats found.

claims.claim: The cited Learn documentation lists supported languages but does not state the fallback for an unsupported Outlook language.
claims.quote: Searched: localized default notification Outlook fallback; Defender localized default fallback. Read Admin review, User reported settings and search excerpts; general locale fallback pages do not specify this feature's fallback.
